house.description: Screen time prohibited for children in preschool and kindergarten.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Education Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to education; prohibiting screen time for children in preschool and kindergarten; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 124D.166.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 124D.166, is amended to read:

124D.166 [-LIMIT-][+ PROHIBITION+] ON SCREEN TIME FOR CHILDREN IN PRESCHOOL AND KINDERGARTEN.
A child in a publicly funded preschool or kindergarten program may not use an individual-use screen, [-such as-] [+including +]a tablet, smartphone, or other digital media[-, without engagement from a teacher or other students-][+ while at a school site+]. This section does not apply to a child for whom the school has an individualized family service plan, an individualized education program, or a 504 plan in effect.

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective July 1, 2026. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; prohibiting screen time for children in preschool and kindergarten; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 124D.166.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 124D.166, is amended to read:

124D.166 PROHIBITION ON SCREEN TIME FOR CHILDREN IN PRESCHOOL AND KINDERGARTEN.
A child in a publicly funded preschool or kindergarten program may not use an individual-use screen, including a tablet, smartphone, or other digital media while at a school site. This section does not apply to a child for whom the school has an individualized family service plan, an individualized education program, or a 504 plan in effect.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2026.
